text:
mia: Quick heads-up — we're planning an early quiesce + connection drain at 01:00 UTC for tenant_shard migration and a small hotpatch that requires an index backfill. Keeping window short, ~20m, but need alignment on deploybot pin and rollback plan.

sam: +1. Can we pin the service version to v3.4.2 during the window? I want the older executor for safe rollback.

anish: I can take the backfill monitor. Confirming the backfill is non-blocking for reads but will write-lock the temp_index for ~10m.

mia: Correct — backfill uses concurrent index build on temp_index then swap. We'll hold writes to tenant_shard during the swap. Read traffic unaffected.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: service=tenant-service env=prod tag=v3.4.2 -> v3.4.3 at 01:05 UTC. Canary=2 hosts, roll 30s. Holdpoint=quiesce_complete. Reactors: notify #incidents on failure.

tasha: Important: include release notes blurb about index swap and the expected 10m write throttle. Ops team needs to update runbook.

ops-oncall: I'll be on standby for the window. If locks exceed 15m or backfill fails, we'll trigger rollback and revert schema flag.

sam: Rollback plan: if swap fails, revert by toggling feature_flag:tenant_index_swap=false and redeploy pinned v3.4.2. Can we add a fast rollback job to cancel swap and restore old index? Anyone already scripted that?

anish: I have a rollback snippet. Paste here:
```
-- rollback: abort swap
BEGIN;
UPDATE system.schema_flags SET value='false' WHERE name='tenant_index_swap';
-- notify listeners to redirect writes to old_index
COMMIT;
```
Will run if post-swap validation fails.

mia: Good. Add a deploy-bot holdpoint post-swap validation (check counts, sample queries). If validation fails, deploy-bot auto-reverts to v3.4.2 and notifies ops.

deploy-bot: holdpoint inserted: validation_check. Auto-rollback on validation_failure=true. Post-action: create incident channel if rollback triggers.

tasha: I've updated the release notes draft and linked the runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/tenant-index-swap. Short blurb and rollback steps included.

ops-oncall: One more ask — please include a DB connection-quiesce command in the preflight step. Example:
```
# preflight: drain connections
curl -X POST https://deploybot/hold?service=tenant-service&drain=true
```

sam: Confirmed. I'll pin traffic by weight 0.0 -> canary route until validation completes.

mia: Thanks everyone. Final checklist before 01:00 UTC: 1) pin v3.4.2 in deploybot, 2) run drain command, 3) run backfill, 4) swap, 5) validation, 6) unpin and post-release notes. I'll post another update 30m before window.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled 30m before window. Good luck :rocket:
